definition: Species label from the Atlas, normalized to lowercase.
Reported protein accession, including any isoform suffix.
One-based residue position reported in the Atlas.
Reported residue label. Blank if the source did not specify a residue.
Atlas records sharing this species, accession, position and residue.
Records whose peptide has a unique sequence match and whose peptide offset supports the reported position.
verified, conflict or unassessed against the Atlas sequence snapshot.
UniProt phosphorylation annotation at the reported residue.
UniProt phosphorylation annotation one to five residues away.
UniProt acetylation annotation one to five residues away.
UniProt ubiquitin acceptor cross-link one to five residues away.
Low-throughput OGT-PIN evidence for the same accession and organism.
Distinct PDB entries with an observed SIFTS segment spanning the coordinate. Segment coverage alone does not confirm the deposited residue.
One PDB entry with confirmed residue identity and observation. Blank when no example was verified.
Deposited chain identifier for the verified PDB example.
Residue identifier in the deposited chain, including its insertion code when present.
Compara panel species with one eligible one-to-one ortholog and an assessable target residue.
Eligible Compara species with the same amino acid at the aligned position.
Eligible Compara species with S or T aligned to an S/T site, or an exact match for another residue.
Identical aligned residue pairs summed over eligible Compara species in the site-centered ±5 window.
Comparable aligned residue pairs in those windows. Denominator for window_identical.
Unique same-taxon OMA protein cross-reference.
Strict OMA group identifier for the parent protein, when available.
Reference species with an assessable target residue in a unique supplementary OMA group alignment.
Assessed OMA reference species with the same amino acid at the aligned position.
Distinct identified proteomics datasets mapped within five residues, including the site.
Distinct same-species physical partners of the matched parent gene product in BioGRID.
Physical partners supported by at least two distinct PubMed identifiers.
Distinct source-record peptide checks, separated by a vertical bar.
AlphaFold local confidence at the verified Atlas residue (0–100). Blank when unavailable.
Exact AlphaFold DB model identifier and version.
Distinct SIFTS candidate entries checked at residue level. Blank when unassessed.
Distinct entries with an observed, matching deposited residue among checked candidates. A lower bound when fewer candidates were checked than spanned the segment.
At least one site record reports low throughput or mutagenesis. Zero requires complete negative evidence. Blank means unassessed.
Mean per-residue AlphaFold pLDDT at the site and up to five residues on either side in the same verified model fragment.
Number of modeled residues contributing to window_mean_plddt, including the site.
